items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Implements exactly the spec + mini-plan, as amended by the plan-review cascade findings.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new I/O paths; pre-existing OSError handler untouched.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, SQL, HTML output, or secrets; reads one local tracked markdown file.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 6 new tests assert on outcomes (counts, excluded_tables); each fails against the pre-fix implementation.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single-pass line walk, O(document length); well under a second on the real 2100+-line ledger.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Source file 299 lines (at guideline). Test file crossed to 311 lines and was split along its own docstring's pre-existing fixture/real-ledger distinction into two files, both now under 300.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Reads a hand-written markdown file, not a machine-generated serialized format; touches_io_boundary did not fire at classification. New excluded_tables JSON key is additive; no other module imports this script.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No new pytest.skip/xfail/.only in the diff; the file's one pytest.skip is pre-existing (a legitimate file-moved/renamed runtime guard).
